label: Slack: Get Thread
description: Read a whole thread: the parent message and every reply, in order, paging until exhausted (capped at 10000 messages; a larger thread fails loudly). Address it by channel + the parent message's ts.

inputs.name: account
inputs.description: The Slack access (wire a SlackAccess node). Reading needs the channels:history scope (groups:history for private channels) and channel membership.

inputs.name: channel
inputs.label: Channel
inputs.placeholder: The channel id the thread lives in

outputs.name: messages
outputs.description: Every message in the thread (parent first), as Slack returns them: text, user, ts, reactions, ...

outputs.name: count
outputs.description: How many messages the thread holds (parent included).
